_lisezmoi: Règles et seuils lus sur GOV.UK le 2026-10-13 (Open Government Licence v3.0). Les barèmes de frais (fees.json), les codes SOC (soc.json), le registre des sponsors (sponsors-meta.json, public/data/sponsors/) et les jours fériés (bank-holidays.json) sortent de scripts/build-data.py ; ce fichier porte tout le reste, chaque bloc avec la clé de sa source. Relire à chaque Statement of Changes (CONTRIBUTING-PAGES.md).

transitional._note: Options F to J: first Skilled Worker permission under the rules before 4 April 2024, continuous since, application before 4 April 2030.

skilledWorker._ashe: SW A1.1: Health and Care ASHE salary jobs, sponsored by the NHS, a listed health body or a care provider regulated by the CQC (or the equivalent bodies elsewhere in the UK): options F to J and Table 2 going rates apply (SW 4.2(b)(i)).

ihs._reduced: Students, their dependants, Youth Mobility Scheme and applicants under 18 at the date of application.

settlement.earnedSettlementStatus: Consultation published 2025-11-28 (Earned settlement). No change to the qualifying periods had been laid in the Immigration Rules by the Statement of Changes HC 584 (in force 8 October 2026).
settlement._absences: Whole days only: the day you leave and the day you return are not counted (continuous residence guidance v10.0). Rolling: no more than 180 days in any 12-month window, for permission granted on or after 11 January 2018.
